description: One or two characteristics of the board's GATT table as a way: a notify one the provider's frames go out on, a written one they come in from (PROVIDER_BLE.MD). Its service is made when it is new.

fields.label: Service
fields.description: The 16-bit UUID of the service they are in: made when it is new

fields.label: Out
fields.description: The notify characteristic the frames go out on; 0: none

fields.label: In
fields.description: The characteristic the client writes; 0: none (at least one of out and in)

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: provider_ble_flag: PROVIDER_BLE_FRAMED, both characteristics carry frames (a session's way); else raw bytes

fields.label: Write flags
fields.description: cmd_send_flag of each write out of the port: CMD_SEND_NOWAIT, the BLE host never waits

fields.label: Name
fields.description: The user description of the characteristics (descriptor 0x2901), NUL-ended; empty: none
